photos.c: BACKPIECE (Photo by E.D. Lacey)---Chris Martin trails the majestic Winbolt-Lewis in a heat of the Surrey Co 220yds. Both qualified for the final, run four days later, in which Vivian was 2nd and Martin 4th. Winbolt-Lewis withdrew.
